info.description: Self-hosted game emulation service. This spec is generated from typed Go handlers via huma — refactoring a request/response struct in code automatically updates the spec.
info.title: Spela API

post.description: Admin-only. One-shot migration that downloads external IGDB/SteamGridDB image URLs and swaps them to local paths.
Admin-only. Starts a background download of missing registry-registered BIOS files.

delete.description: Admin-only. Removes a BIOS file from disk.

post.description: Admin-only. Runs a synchronous cheat-database import and returns the result.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns counts of total cheats, games with cheats, total games, and verified games.
Admin-only. Returns the compatibility matrix between native-player cores and EmulatorJS cores per console.

post.description: Admin-only. Starts a background IGDB enrichment pass. Mode 'missing' (default) enriches games without themes; 'all' enriches every IGDB-scraped game.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns whether an enrichment pass is active and its current progress.

post.description: Admin-only. Starts a library scan in the background. Returns 202 immediately; progress is reported via WebSocket events.

parameters.description: Optional console abbreviation to scan only that console's games.
parameters.name: console

schema.description: Optional console abbreviation to scan only that console's games.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns whether a scan is currently active and the latest phase / progress.

post.description: Admin-only. Deletes the achievement cache entries for a game so the next request re-fetches from RetroAchievements.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns all known cover sources (LibRetro, IGDB, regional LibRetro variants) and which source is currently active.
get.summary: List available cover art options for a game

put.description: Admin-only. Selects one of the available cover sources and sets it as the active cover on the game record.
put.summary: Switch the active cover art for a game

get.description: Admin-only. Returns hero art options fetched from SteamGridDB for the game.
get.summary: List available hero art options from SteamGridDB

put.description: Admin-only. Downloads the supplied SteamGridDB image locally and stores it as the game's hero art.
put.summary: Set the active hero art for a game

post.description: Admin-only. Re-runs metadata scraping using the supplied IGDB game ID.
post.summary: Re-scrape a game with a chosen IGDB match

get.description: Admin-only. Searches IGDB scoped to the game's platform for possible matches.
get.summary: Search IGDB for candidates for a game

post.description: Admin-only. Manually updates metadata fields on a game. Only provided fields are applied.
Admin-only. Enqueues a single game for scraping, attaching to the active job if any.

put.description: Admin-only. Sets a custom verification tag on a game for bookkeeping.

get.description: Admin-only. Reports whether IGDB is configured via env vars, DB settings, or not at all.

post.description: Admin-only. Validates a clientId/clientSecret pair by attempting a Twitch token exchange.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns unscraped, unverified, and incomplete games (scraped only via LibRetro fallback).
Admin-only. Returns whether the server-level RA API key is configured and the credential source (env, database, none).

delete.description: Admin-only. Cancels the currently running scrape job. Kicks off a post-cancel variant-regroup pass.

post.description: Admin-only. Enqueues matching games for scraping. Supports conflict resolution (reject/replace/merge) if another scrape is active.

parameters.description: Filter by scrape source (igdb, libretro, steamgriddb).
parameters.name: source

schema.description: Filter by scrape source (igdb, libretro, steamgriddb).

parameters.description: Filter by scrape status (matched, not_found, error, not_attempted).
parameters.name: status

schema.description: Filter by scrape status (matched, not_found, error, not_attempted).

get.description: Admin-only. Returns aggregate scrape result counts per source (matched, not found, error, not attempted).
Admin-only. Returns the current scrape job state (active, counts, mode).
Admin-only. Returns server settings as a flat key/value map; secret keys (client secrets, API keys) are masked with ********.

put.description: Admin-only. Updates server settings. Only allowlisted keys are accepted. Secret keys whose value is the mask placeholder are skipped.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns total counts of users, games, consoles with games, and session saves.
Admin-only. Returns whether SteamGridDB is configured and the credential source (env, database, none).
Admin-only. Returns a paginated, filterable list of system events (auth, audit, operational). Supports category, eventType, dismissed, username, ip and since filters.

parameters.description: Set to 'true' to include dismissed events.
parameters.name: dismissed

schema.description: Set to 'true' to include dismissed events.

parameters.description: Filter by one or more event types (repeatable).
parameters.name: eventType

schema.description: Filter by one or more event types (repeatable).

parameters.description: Time window: 1h, 24h/1d, 7d, 30d, all, or an RFC3339 timestamp. Defaults to the last 30 days.
parameters.name: since

schema.description: Time window: 1h, 24h/1d, 7d, 30d, all, or an RFC3339 timestamp. Defaults to the last 30 days.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns the seeded set of system event categories.
Admin-only. Returns every event type the server may emit with its category classification.
get.summary: Get the system event type catalog

get.description: Admin-only. Returns the full system event record with metadata.

put.description: Admin-only. Marks the event as dismissed (sets dismissed_at). Dismissed events are hidden from the default list view.

delete.description: Admin-only. Deletes every staged ROM from disk and drops all staging records. Alias for reject-all.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns all currently staged ROM uploads, newest first.

post.description: Admin-only. Accepts every upload currently in ready or pending_scrape state (with a console set).
Admin-only. Deletes every staged ROM from disk and drops the staging records.
Admin-only. Runs metadata scraping + duplicate detection on every upload currently in pending_scrape state.

get.description: Admin-only. Verifies that the staging/game library directory is writable.
get.summary: Check whether the game library directory is writable

post.description: Admin-only. Moves the staged ROM into the library and creates a Game record.
Admin-only. Resolves console ambiguity on a staged upload by explicitly choosing the console abbreviation.
post.summary: Set the console for a staged upload

post.description: Admin-only. Deletes the staged ROM from disk and drops the staging record.
Admin-only. Runs metadata scraping + duplicate detection on a staged upload. Requires the console to be set first.
post.summary: Scrape metadata for a staged upload

get.description: Admin-only. Returns the full list of (non-soft-deleted) user records.

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a new user account with a hashed password. Role defaults to 'user' if not specified; 'owner' is rejected.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns soft-deleted user records eligible for permanent deletion.

delete.description: Admin-only. Soft-deletes a user and cascades to per-user preferences, devices, social data, collections, shared saves, RA credentials, challenges, shared sessions, netplay sessions and refresh tokens.

put.description: Admin-only. Updates role, email, password, disabled or pendingApproval fields. Owner role is protected from changes.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns all devices registered to the specified user with per-console shader preferences.

delete.description: Admin-only. Removes the user and all associated data from the database. Requires the user to already be soft-deleted.
Admin-only. Clears failed-login counters for a user.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns failed login counters and lockout status for a user.
get.summary: Get a user's login rate-limit status

get.description: Returns registry-driven BIOS file status plus per-console summaries.
Paginated list of challenges with gameId/consoleId/difficulty/type/status/creatorId filters and newest/popular/oldest sort.

parameters.description: Filter by console ID (JOINs on games).
parameters.name: consoleId

schema.description: Filter by console ID (JOINs on games).

parameters.description: Filter by status (active/closed/expired). Defaults to active.
parameters.name: status

schema.description: Filter by status (active/closed/expired). Defaults to active.

delete.description: Deletes a challenge and all its attempts and stored save/screenshot files. Allowed for the creator or an admin/owner.

get.description: Returns a single challenge including creator, game and console metadata. Expired challenges are lazily closed on read.

put.description: Updates name/description/status on a challenge. Allowed for the creator or an admin/owner.

get.description: Returns the caller's attempts (any status) for the specified challenge, newest first.
get.summary: List the caller's attempts for a challenge

post.description: Creates a new in-progress attempt for the caller. Any existing in-progress attempt for the same user/challenge is abandoned. Rate-limited per-user/per-challenge.
Marks the specified in-progress attempt as abandoned.
Marks the attempt as completed and updates best-attempt / leaderboard state. Emits challenge_completed and optionally challenge_record activity events.

get.description: Returns the best attempts across users, ranked fastest-first (or longest-first for survival). Paginated.
get.summary: Get the leaderboard for a challenge

get.description: Paginated list of the caller's collections, newest first. Supports optional name substring search.

parameters.description: Optional substring match on collection name.
parameters.name: search

schema.description: Optional substring match on collection name.

post.description: Creates a new game collection owned by the caller.

get.description: Paginated list of public collections across all users, newest first.

parameters.description: Optional substring match on collection name.
parameters.name: search

schema.description: Optional substring match on collection name.

delete.description: Owner-only. Removes the collection and its items.

get.description: Returns the collection detail and the full ordered game list. Only the owner can see private collections.
get.summary: Get a collection with its games

put.description: Owner-only. Partial update of name, description or visibility.

post.description: Owner-only. Appends the game to the end of the collection (unique per collection).
post.summary: Add a game to a collection

delete.description: Owner-only. Removes the specified game from the collection.
delete.summary: Remove a game from a collection

get.description: Returns all consoles that have at least one primary, non-pre-release game, sorted by generation and name.
Returns a paginated list of games for the specified console. Supports search, letter, region, sort, grouped (primary-variants-only) and hidePreRelease filters.

parameters.description: Alphabet quick-jump filter ('A'-'Z' or '#' for non-alpha).
parameters.name: letter

schema.description: Alphabet quick-jump filter ('A'-'Z' or '#' for non-alpha).

get.description: Per-console variant of the longest-games list, scoped to the supplied console abbreviation.
Per-console variant of the top-rated available list, scoped to the supplied console abbreviation.
Per-console variant of the critic top-rated list, scoped to the supplied console abbreviation.
Returns the cached top-rated IGDB games for the specified console. Refreshed from IGDB when cached data is older than 7 days.
Returns all libretro cores known to the server, including display name, supported platforms, and download URL (where applicable).

post.description: Records a client-facing emulator failure (core download, WASM compile, missing ROM) as an operational system event for admin visibility.

get.description: Returns the 10 most recent active Challenge entities that have not yet expired.
Returns up to 20 games currently with active shared sessions and/or active challenges, sorted by combined activity.
get.summary: Get games with active shared sessions or challenges

get.description: Returns games where the caller has completed between 80 and 99 percent of achievements.
get.summary: Get games the caller has nearly completed

get.description: Returns a paginated stream of IGDB promotional artwork with game metadata.
Returns up to 30 highest-rated games released in the given year.
get.summary: Get top-rated games from a specific release year

get.description: Returns games with the highest average user ratings on this server (at least 2 ratings).
get.summary: Get top-rated games by the community

get.description: Returns a compact list of consoles with game counts and top game for the explore page quick-jump row.
Returns aggregated showcase data for a specific console: essentials, hidden gems, genre breakdown, top developers, recently played, recently added.
Returns a paginated dense cover art feed with minimal metadata. Supports console filter.
Returns games where the community rates higher than critics — avg community rating >= 4.0 with IGDB rating < 75.
Returns up to 30 highest-rated games for the given decade (80s, 90s, or 00s).
get.summary: Get best games of a decade

get.description: Returns the top 50 developers by game count with average rating and console coverage.
Returns a rotating spotlight of a top developer with games that have hero art. Rotates weekly.
Returns all games by a specific developer along with statistics (rating distribution, genre/platform breakdown, user stats, timeline, related developers).
Returns up to 20 games with the highest average achievement completion rate across players.
get.summary: Get games with highest avg achievement completion

get.description: Returns up to 10 featured games selected via weighted random sampling, stable per-day.
get.summary: Get featured games for the explore hero carousel

get.description: Returns personalized recommendation shelves derived from the caller's play history.
Returns up to 20 games with cached achievements where the caller has zero unlocks yet.
get.summary: Get games with cached achievements the caller hasn't started

get.description: Returns up to 20 games with the lowest average achievement completion rate. Requires at least 2 players attempting.
get.summary: Get games with lowest avg achievement completion

get.description: Returns up to 20 games matching the chosen mood (chill, challenge, nostalgia, something-new, quick, together).
get.summary: Get games matching a specific mood

get.description: Returns the static list of moods available in the mood picker.
Returns up to 20 games released on today's month/day across all years, sorted oldest first.
get.summary: Get games released on today's month/day

get.description: Returns games favourited by users whose favourites overlap with the caller's. Uses Jaccard similarity.
Returns all games by a specific publisher along with statistics (rating distribution, genre/platform breakdown, user stats, timeline, related publishers).
Returns the 20 most recent user reviews (non-empty review text) with game + reviewer metadata.
get.summary: Get games with recent user reviews

get.description: Returns curated shelves (top-rated, recently-added, hidden gems, most-played). Empty rows are omitted.
Returns a paginated stream of screenshots with minimal game metadata. Supports console/genre filters.
Returns up to 20 top series with at least 2 library games, sorted by library game count DESC.
Returns a single random game matching optional console/genre/min-rating filters.
Returns up to 20 games with the most distinct players in the last 7 days.
Returns the static decision wizard configuration (steps + options).
Returns 5 game recommendations based on the wizard's mood/era/vibe selections.
Returns games the caller played roughly 1..10 years ago (within a 3-day window of today's date).
Returns all franchises with at least one game in the library.
Returns a franchise with all its games (local and non-local). Falls back to lookup by IGDB franchise ID.

parameters.description: Franchise group ID, or IGDB franchise ID as fallback.
parameters.name: id

schema.description: Franchise group ID, or IGDB franchise ID as fallback.

get.description: Returns paginated games in a franchise (by IGDB franchise ID).

Returns a paginated list of games across all consoles. Supports console, genre, theme, keyword, perspective, developer, publisher, region, search, letter, year-range, rating-range, play-status, grouped, and hidePreRelease filters.

parameters.description: Legacy alias for consoles (single console abbreviation).
parameters.name: consoleId

schema.description: Legacy alias for consoles (single console abbreviation).

parameters.description: Alphabet quick-jump filter ('A'-'Z' or '#' for non-alpha).
parameters.name: letter

schema.description: Alphabet quick-jump filter ('A'-'Z' or '#' for non-alpha).

parameters.description: Restrict to unplayed | played | favorited | play-later for the current user.
parameters.name: playStatus

schema.description: Restrict to unplayed | played | favorited | play-later for the current user.

parameters.description: Sort column (title, created_at, file_size, rating, release_date).
parameters.name: sortBy

schema.description: Sort column (title, created_at, file_size, rating, release_date).

get.description: Returns the full enriched game record including variants, ROM-hack references, BIOS status and user-scoped data.
Returns per-user achievement counts and points for a specific game, sorted by unlocked count.
Returns the caller's achievement progress for a specific game, enriched with playTimeAtUnlock. Returns an empty array if no RA account is linked.
Returns the caller's achievement timeline for a specific game, ordered chronologically.
Returns the SteamGridDB hero, grid, logo, and icon artwork URLs for a game. Returns an empty response (not 404) when no artwork has been scraped yet.
Paginated list of active challenges for the specified game, newest first.
Returns all cheat codes associated with the specified game, ordered by cheat index.
get.summary: Get cheat codes for a game

get.description: Returns the recommended libretro core for the game — either the full Core record (when known to the server) or a bare {coreName} fallback.
get.summary: Get recommended libretro core for a game

get.description: Returns up to 20 other games by the same developer that are in the local library.
get.summary: Get other games by the same developer

get.description: Returns the franchises that the specified game belongs to with total/library game counts.
get.summary: Get franchises a game belongs to

delete.description: Clears the user's currently-playing game in the WebSocket hub. The path-level game ID is accepted for symmetry with POST but is not inspected.

parameters.description: Game ID (path placeholder; not used server-side).
parameters.name: id

schema.description: Game ID (path placeholder; not used server-side).

delete.summary: Clear the authenticated user's currently-playing status

post.description: Adds the supplied number of seconds to the caller's play history for the specified game and marks them as currently playing it. Records daily activity for the play heatmap.
post.summary: Increment the authenticated user's play time for a game

delete.description: Removes the authenticated user's rating for the specified game.
delete.summary: Delete the caller's rating for a game

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all user ratings for the specified game, newest first.

post.description: Upserts the authenticated user's rating for the specified game. Returns 201 on create, 200 on update.
post.summary: Create or update the caller's rating for a game

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's rating for the specified game, or 404 if none is set.
get.summary: Get the caller's rating for a game

get.description: Returns the average rating, total count and 1-5 distribution for the specified game.
get.summary: Get the aggregated rating summary for a game

post.description: Returns {status:'already_scraped'} if the game has metadata, {status:'already_queued'} if a scrape is pending, or 202 {status:'queued'} if a new scrape job was enqueued.
post.summary: Enqueue a game for scraping if not already scraped

get.description: Returns the series (with library and total game counts) that the specified game belongs to.
get.summary: Get series a game belongs to

get.description: Returns the caller's sessions for the specified game plus any backing sessions from shared sessions they're a member of.

post.description: Creates a new game session owned by the authenticated user.
post.summary: Create a session for a game

get.description: Returns a paginated list of community-shared save states for the specified game, newest first.
get.summary: List community shared saves for a game

delete.description: Removes a shared save state. Allowed for the owner or an admin/owner role.

get.description: Returns active shared sessions for the specified game, newest updated first.
get.summary: List active shared sessions for a game

get.description: Returns IGDB-sourced similar games for a local game. Results are cached locally and refreshed from IGDB when older than 7 days.
Returns total player count, total/average play time and up to 10 top players by play time for the specified game.
get.summary: Get aggregate community play stats for a game

get.description: Returns server status and version. Used by load balancers and uptime monitors.
Returns the top N keywords by game count (default 50, max 200).

parameters.description: Maximum number of keywords (defaults to 50, clamped to 1-200).
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Maximum number of keywords (defaults to 50, clamped to 1-200).

get.description: Returns paginated games tagged with the specified IGDB keyword.
Returns hardware makers (Nintendo, Sega, etc.) that have at least one console with games in the library.
Returns a single hardware maker along with the consoles it produces that currently have at least one game in the library.
Returns the caller's pending netplay invites wrapped in a { data, total } envelope.
get.summary: List pending netplay invites for the caller

get.description: Returns the number of pending netplay invites for the authenticated user.
get.summary: Count pending netplay invites for the caller

post.description: Marks the invite as accepted and expires other pending invites for the same session.
Marks the invite as declined.

get.description: Returns the caller's sessions (as host or client) plus currently-waiting sessions (under 15 minutes old). Paginated.
get.summary: List netplay sessions for the caller

post.description: Creates a new netplay session with a generated 6-character invite code. Only supported on a curated set of consoles (NES, SNES, GB/GBC/GBA, GEN).
Atomically joins a waiting session by its 6-character invite code. Fails with 409 if the session is already full.
post.summary: Join a netplay session via invite code

delete.description: Host can delete any session they own; admin/owner can force-delete. Associated invites are expired and records cleaned up.

get.description: Returns netplay session details with host, client, game and console metadata.
get.summary: Get a netplay session by ID

get.description: Host-only. Returns every invite ever sent for the specified netplay session, newest first.
get.summary: List invites for a netplay session

post.description: Host-only. Invites a user by username. The session must be in the waiting state and the invitee must not already have a pending invite.
post.summary: Invite a user to a netplay session

post.description: Ends the session. endReason is host_left or client_left depending on who leaves.

put.description: Host-only. Updates the input delay (1-10 frames) for the session.

get.description: Performs a global search across games, consoles, developers, publishers, collections, series and franchises and returns each category's top matches plus a total count.

parameters.description: Maximum number of results per category. Defaults to 5, clamped to 1-50.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Maximum number of results per category. Defaults to 5, clamped to 1-50.

get.summary: Global search across games, consoles, people and lists

get.description: Returns series with at least one local game, sorted by library game count.
Returns a series with all its games (local and non-local).

delete.description: Owner-only. Deletes all save state files and records, SRAM data, and the session directory.
delete.summary: Delete a session and its saves

get.description: Returns session details including shared-session membership metadata when applicable.

put.description: Owner-only. Partial update — nil fields are left unchanged.
put.summary: Update a session's name, cheats flag, or core

get.description: Returns cheatsEnabled flag and the list of enabled cheat indices.
get.summary: Get cheat configuration for a session

put.description: Owner-only. Replaces the session's enabled-cheats set and updates the cheatsEnabled flag.
put.summary: Update cheat configuration for a session

post.description: Creates a copy of the session (owned by the caller) including saves, SRAM, cheats and screenshot.

delete.description: Owner-only. Clears the session's last_played_by field.
delete.summary: Clear the last-played-by marker on a session

post.description: Owner-only. Adds the supplied seconds to the session's total play time and marks the caller as last played by.
post.summary: Record play time for a session

delete.description: Owner-only. Removes every save state (auto, manual, slot) from disk and DB. The session itself is kept.
delete.summary: Delete all saves for a session

get.description: Returns all save states (manual, auto, slot) for the specified session ordered by creation time descending.
get.summary: List save states in a session

get.description: Returns all slot-based saves (slots 1-10) for the specified session ordered by slot number.
get.summary: List slot saves for a session

delete.description: Owner-only. Removes the specified save state's file and record.

put.description: Owner-only. Partial update — nil fields are left unchanged.
put.summary: Update a save state's name or notes

get.description: Returns shared sessions where the caller is a member, newest updated first.
get.summary: List shared sessions the caller is a member of

post.description: Creates a new shared session backed by a GameSession, auto-adds the caller as owner member, and broadcasts a shared-session-created event.

delete.description: Owner-only. Cleans up saves, invites, members and the shared-session record.

get.description: Returns shared-session details including member list. Requires membership.
get.summary: Get a shared session by ID

put.description: Owner-only. Partial update — nil fields are left unchanged. Valid statuses: active, completed, archived.
put.summary: Update a shared session's name or status

post.description: Refreshes turn_taken_at so the timeout doesn't expire. Only the current turn holder can call this.
Requires membership. Invites a user by username. Duplicate active invites return 409. Previously declined invites are cleared before creating the new one.
post.summary: Invite a user to a shared session

post.description: Removes the caller from the shared session. Owners cannot leave — they must transfer ownership or delete the session.

delete.description: Owner-only. Removes the specified member. If the removed user held the turn, it's released.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a shared session

post.description: Clears the active turn for the shared session. Only the current turn holder can call this.
post.summary: Release the caller's turn on a shared session

get.description: Requires membership. Returns saves newest first.
get.summary: List save states for a shared session

delete.description: Owner-only. Removes the save's file and DB record.

put.description: Requires membership. Updates the save's display name.

post.description: Atomically acquires the turn. Returns a turnToken that save-upload requests must provide. Fails with 409 if another member holds the turn.
post.summary: Take the turn on a shared session

get.description: Returns a paginated activity feed (most recent first) with per-event user and game metadata.
Returns users currently connected via WebSocket, optionally with the game they are currently playing.
Returns the top 25 players across the server ranked by total play time.
Returns the top 25 most-played games across all users, sorted by total play time descending.
Returns all themes with at least one game in the library, sorted by game count descending.
Returns paginated games tagged with the specified IGDB theme, sorted by rating descending.
Returns the games with the highest time-to-beat values, ranked descending.
Returns top-rated IGDB games that have a matching local game on the server, ranked by total rating descending.
Returns IGDB critic top-rated games that have a matching local game on the server, ranked by critic rating descending.
Returns the top 20 top-rated IGDB games across all consoles, deduplicated by IGDB game ID, preferring entries whose console has a local library match.
Returns the caller's 20 most recently unlocked achievements across all games.
Returns the caller's showcased achievements in display order.

put.description: Replaces the caller's showcased achievements. Maximum 5 entries.

get.description: Returns every unlocked achievement across all games, enriched with title, badge and rarity. Used by the showcase picker.
Paginated list of challenges authored by the caller, newest first.
get.summary: List challenges created by the caller

get.description: Returns a per-console breakdown of games played vs total + an overall percentage.
get.summary: Get the caller's per-console completion stats

get.description: Returns the caller's registered devices with per-console shader preferences.

post.description: Upserts a device by (user, deviceUuid). Returns the device with its per-console shader preferences.

delete.description: Removes a device and its per-console shader preferences.

put.description: Updates the device name for a device owned by the caller.

get.description: Returns per-console shader overrides for the device.

put.description: Upserts per-console shader preferences for the device; empty/'none' removes the override.

get.description: Returns breadth-of-exploration achievements (consoles, genres, decades, games played, hours).
Returns a flat list of the authenticated user's favorited games with enrichment data (play history, ratings, artwork).

delete.description: Unfavorites the specified game for the authenticated user.
delete.summary: Remove a game from the caller's favorites

post.description: Marks the specified game as favorited for the authenticated user. Emits a favorited_game activity event on success.
post.summary: Add a game to the caller's favorites

delete.description: Removes the caller's custom key mapping for a specific game, reverting to the console default.

get.description: Returns the caller's custom key mapping override for a specific game.

put.description: Upserts the caller's custom key mapping for a specific game.
Verifies the current password, sets a new one, revokes existing refresh tokens and blacklists the current access token.

parameters.description: Bearer access token; used to blacklist the current access token after a successful change.
parameters.name: Authorization

schema.description: Bearer access token; used to blacklist the current access token after a successful change.

get.description: Returns the caller's daily play activity for the last 365 days.
Returns the authenticated user's Play Later queue as a flat game list, ordered by the user-defined position.
get.summary: List the caller's Play Later queue

put.description: Replaces the user-defined order of the caller's Play Later queue. The supplied gameIds list must include every game currently in the queue.
put.summary: Reorder the caller's Play Later queue

delete.description: Removes the specified game from the authenticated user's Play Later queue.
delete.summary: Remove a game from the caller's Play Later queue

post.description: Idempotent: adds the game at the end of the queue (position = max+1). Returns 201 for new entries, 200 when the game was already present.
post.summary: Append a game to the caller's Play Later queue

get.description: Returns a flat list of {gameId, playTime, lastPlayedAt} entries for every game the caller has played.
Returns the authenticated user's emulation preferences including shaders, themes, key mappings, preferred regions and RetroAchievements status.

put.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's emulation preferences. Nil fields are left untouched. Also upserts per-console shader and key-mapping overrides.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile (username, email, role, avatar, timestamps).

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's email and/or avatar URL. Changing the email requires the current password to be supplied.

delete.description: Removes the caller's stored RA credentials.

post.description: Exchanges username + password for a RetroAchievements token and stores it encrypted for the caller.

put.description: Updates RA-specific settings for the caller (currently only the hardcore flag).

get.description: Returns whether the caller has linked a RA account, the linked username, and the hardcore flag.
Returns the caller's RA username and decrypted token. Response is marked no-store.
get.summary: Get RA credentials for the native player

get.description: Returns the caller's 20 most recently played games with embedded play history.
Returns all saved searches for the caller, newest first.

post.description: Persists a named search filter for the caller. Up to 50 saved searches per user.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a saved search owned by the caller.

post.description: Keeps only the most recent auto-save and manual save per session for the caller. Aggressive cleanup; use when quota is tight.

get.description: Returns pending shared session invites for the authenticated user.
get.summary: List pending shared session invites for the caller

get.description: Returns the number of pending shared session invites for the authenticated user.
get.summary: Count pending shared session invites for the caller

post.description: Marks the invite as accepted and adds the caller as a member. Emits a joined_shared_session activity event.
Marks the invite as declined.

get.description: Returns the caller's aggregate play time, games played, streaks, and most-played game.
Returns the caller's total save storage, per-console breakdown and quota.
Returns the caller's genre / theme / top-console breakdown derived from play history.
Returns users the caller has shared netplay or shared sessions with in the last 6 months, sorted by most recent interaction.
get.summary: Get the caller's recent play partners

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users matching the supplied username prefix (or all non-disabled users when the query is empty), excluding the authenticated user.
Returns another user's showcased achievements.
Returns another user's daily play activity for the last 365 days.
Returns a user's public profile including stats, favorite games, recent games, and top-played games.
